question: Can i do a ride along with a police officer?
text:
Yes—if your local police department or sheriff’s office offers **civilian ride-alongs**, you can apply to accompany a patrol officer as an observer. You don’t have to be applying for a police job to join a civilian program. ([austintexas.gov](https://www.austintexas.gov/services/apply-apd-ride-along-program?utm_source=openai))

Search your department’s website for “ride-along,” or call its **non-emergency number** and ask how to apply. Requirements vary: you may need to sign a waiver, meet a minimum age, and apply a few weeks in advance. ([austintexas.gov](https://www.austintexas.gov/services/apply-apd-ride-along-program?utm_source=openai))

What city and state are you in? I can help you find the right application.
